sources.query: query PicaSourceHostSources($first: Int!, $offset: Int!) { sources(first: $first, offset: $offset) { nodes { id name lang supportsLatest } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } totalCount } }

library.query: query PicaHostLibrary($offset: Int!) { mangas(condition: { inLibrary: true }, first: 25, offset: $offset) { nodes { id sourceId url title inLibrary } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } }

manga.query: query PicaHostManga($id: Int!) { manga(id: $id) { id sourceId url title inLibrary chapters { nodes { id mangaId url name sourceOrder pageCount chapterNumber } } } }

chapter.query: query PicaHostChapter($id: Int!) { chapter(id: $id) { id mangaId url name sourceOrder pageCount chapterNumber } }

pages.query: mutation PicaHostChapterPages($id: Int!) { fetchChapterPages(input: { chapterId: $id }) { chapter { id mangaId url name sourceOrder pageCount chapterNumber } pages } }

search.query: mutation PicaHostSourceSearch($input: FetchSourceMangaInput!) { fetchSourceManga(input: $input) { mangas { id sourceId url title inLibrary } hasNextPage } }

prepare.query: mutation PicaHostPrepareManga($input: FetchMangaAndChaptersInput!) { fetchMangaAndChapters(input: $input) { manga { id sourceId url title inLibrary } chapters { id mangaId url name sourceOrder pageCount chapterNumber } } }
